Not a chance.|Vuffi Raa and Lando Calrissian, installing a seating rack on the ''Millennium Falcon'' for Quor'sav passenger Waywa Fybot|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>}}
A '''seating rack''' was a device designed for the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] to perch upon. It looked similar to a normal chair, but altered for [[Bird/Legends|bird]]-like beings who did not sit on their posteriors like [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and his partner [[Vuffi Raa]] installed such a device aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] for use by the Quor'sav police officer [[Waywa Fybot]]. For [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]], the Quor'sav utilized a [[resting rack]].<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon" />
